oracle.name: Dataverse Web API (hosted environment)
oracle.scope: Two hosted runs on 2026-11-27 (dc2ka, dc2kb) of twenty-six calculated columns per run, each saved by the classic calculated-field designer (opened from the Maker column panel) and read from the run's Solution export: AddHours, AddDays, AddWeeks, AddMonths, AddYears and the five Subtract functions, DiffInMinutes, DiffInHours, DiffInDays, DiffInWeeks, DiffInMonths and DiffInYears, TrimLeft, TrimRight, Concat with a null, a related parent column, a Yes/No column, And and Or conditions, a column-to-column condition, ELSE IF chains, text conditions (begins with, ends with, contains, does not begin with) and a date condition, over six invented child rows (month ends, a leap day, a negative span, equal dates, a span across the year end, nulls). Establishes each value read after seeding and after two source updates; the creation time is kept as its UTC date.
